title: Concept: Build resolves artifacts from the developer machine
description: build.gradle declares a `mavenLocal()` repository, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A dependency resolved from a local path or a mutable branch is not the published artifact the rest of the project audits. This rule reads a `mavenLocal()` repository.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through build.gradle (gradle).
risk: A dependency resolved from a local path or a mutable branch is not the published artifact the rest of the project audits. This rule reads a `mavenLocal()` repository.
